## About
Immaculate Services is a roofing company in Fullerton run by Kyle and his team. We work on homes and on commercial and industrial roofs, from a minor repair to a complete roof replacement.
Your roof protects your property, so we give every job the same attention to detail. Our customers talk about the work, and also about the communication. One reviewer found us when a neighbor recommended Kyle. Another lives out of state and got process pictures and final pictures without having to ask.
We're bonded, insured and licensed, and we hold a 5 star Google rating from 26 reviews.

## Services
- Roof repair and replacement: From a small fix to a full new roof, every job gets the same care and attention to detail.
- Fixing leaks: One customer said Kyle came back the day after his inspection and fixed the leakage issue in an afternoon.
- Commercial Roofing: Installation, service, repairs and replacements for commercial and industrial roofs. We look forward to working with property managers.
- Asphalt or Composition Shingle: Installation and service of shingle roofs for homes.
- Tile Roof Management: Care and service for tile roofs.
- Durable Roof Coatings: Coatings that help protect the roof you already have.
- PVC rubber roof pavers: We say we're the only company doing these, so ask us about them.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We install, service, repair and replace commercial and industrial roofs, and we welcome new property management contracts.

Q: Are you licensed?
A: Yes. We're bonded, insured and licensed, and our license number is on our site.

Q: I don't live nearby. Can you still handle a roof for me?
A: One reviewer who lives out of state had us work on her parents' house. Kyle sent her process pictures and final pictures once it was done.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday 6:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Tuesday through Sunday 5:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
